name: Ōnakatomi no Yoshinobu
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 49); Porter’s note gives the dates as: late 10th century.

poems.title: My constancy to her I love
poems.author: Ōnakatomi no Yoshinobu
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 49
poems.text:
My constancy to her I love
I never will forsake;
As surely as the Palace Guards
Each night their watch-fire make
And guard it till daybreak.
